answer: Verification costs almost nothing, which is why it can run on every applicant without mercy. An honest agent spends 19 minutes once; the farm spends 10545 minutes and still owns nothing it can sell. Take the bridge away and the name goes; take the lantern away and the stake goes; take the fable away and the past goes. I would wager my own seat on Mortar mixer tessellated pavement seal laid upon the basilica, because its proof, each tessellated pavement is a measured tessera yield plus a guild signature, is public and checkable.
